title: Reservoir-Pump-Tank Elevation Loop
description: Single-zone pumped water supply system lifting flow from a clearwell reservoir through a centrifugal booster pump to an elevated storage tank and demand junction.
code:
[TITLE]
Reservoir-Pump-Tank Elevation Loop

[JUNCTIONS]
;ID              Elev         Demand       Pattern
 J1              10           0            ;
 J2              45           25           ;
 J3              40           30           ;

[RESERVOIRS]
;ID              Head         Pattern
 R1              15           ;

[TANKS]
;ID              Elev         InitLvl      MinLvl       MaxLvl       Diam         MinVol       VolCurve
 T1              65           12           4            20           15.0         0            ;

[PIPES]
;ID              Node1        Node2        Length       Diam         Roughness    MinorLoss    Status
 P1              J1           J2           1200         300          120          0            OPEN
 P2              J2           J3           850          250          120          0            OPEN
 P3              J2           T1           400          300          120          0            OPEN

[PUMPS]
;ID              Node1        Node2        Parameters
 PMP1            R1           J1           HEAD PumpCurve1

[CURVES]
;ID              X-Value      Y-Value
 PumpCurve1      0            95
 PumpCurve1      40           82
 PumpCurve1      80           58

[OPTIONS]
 Units                LPS
 Headloss             H-W
 Accuracy             0.001
 Trials               40

[END]

title: Looped 6-Node Municipal Pipe Grid

title: Extended-Period 24-Hour Tank Fill/Drain with Controls
description: 24-hour extended-period hydraulic simulation of a pumped storage system with diurnal demand pattern multipliers and automated tank-level pump controls.
code:
[TITLE]
Extended-Period 24-Hour Tank Fill/Drain with Automated Pump Controls

[JUNCTIONS]
;ID              Elev         Demand       Pattern
 J10             20           0            ;
 J11             35           18           Pat1
 J12             32           24           Pat1
 J13             28           20           Pat1
 J14             30           15           Pat1

[RESERVOIRS]
;ID              Head         Pattern
 LakeSource      25           ;

[TANKS]
;ID              Elev         InitLvl      MinLvl       MaxLvl       Diam         MinVol       VolCurve
 MainTank        68           10           3            18           18.0         0            ;

[PIPES]
;ID              Node1        Node2        Length       Diam         Roughness    MinorLoss    Status
 P10             J10          J11          900          350          125          0            OPEN
 P11             J11          J12          750          300          120          0            OPEN
 P12             J12          J13          680          250          120          0            OPEN
 P13             J11          J14          820          250          120          0            OPEN
 P14             J14          J13          700          200          115          0            OPEN
 P15             J10          MainTank     450          350          125          0            OPEN

[PUMPS]
;ID              Node1        Node2        Parameters
 BoostPump       LakeSource   J10          HEAD PumpH1

[CURVES]
;ID              X-Value      Y-Value
 PumpH1          0            80
 PumpH1          50           72
 PumpH1          100          54

[PATTERNS]
;ID              Multipliers
 Pat1            0.55  0.50  0.65  1.15  1.40  1.25
 Pat1            1.05  1.00  1.10  1.35  1.20  0.75

[CONTROLS]
 LINK BoostPump OPEN IF NODE MainTank BELOW 6.0
 LINK BoostPump CLOSED IF NODE MainTank ABOVE 16.0

[TIMES]
 Duration             24:00
 Hydraulic Timestep   1:00
 Pattern Timestep     2:00
 Report Timestep      1:00

[OPTIONS]
 Units                LPS
 Headloss             H-W
 Accuracy             0.001
 Trials               40

[END]

title: Chlorine Decay Water Quality Transport
description: 48-hour hydraulic and water-quality advection-reaction simulation tracking free chlorine residual decay across bulk fluid and pipe walls with reservoir booster dosing.
code:

Chlorine Decay Water Quality Transport Model

[JUNCTIONS]
;ID              Elev         Demand       Pattern
 J1              40           0            ;
 J2              38           16           DemandPat
 J3              35           22           DemandPat
 J4              33           19           DemandPat
 J5              30           14           DemandPat
 J6              28           12           DemandPat

[RESERVOIRS]
;ID              Head         Pattern
 WTP_Clearwell   45           ;

[TANKS]
;ID              Elev         InitLvl      MinLvl       MaxLvl       Diam         MinVol       VolCurve
 EastTank        78           11           4            16           16.0         0            ;

[PIPES]
;ID              Node1        Node2        Length       Diam         Roughness    MinorLoss    Status
 P1              J1           J2           1100         350          130          0            OPEN
 P2              J2           J3           950          300          120          0            OPEN
 P3              J3           J4           880          250          115          0            OPEN
 P4              J2           J5           1050         250          115          0            OPEN
 P5              J5           J6           920          200          110          0            OPEN
 P6              J4           J6           840          200          110          0            OPEN
 P7              J3           EastTank     500          300          125          0            OPEN

[PUMPS]
;ID              Node1        Node2        Parameters
 WTP_Pump        WTP_Clearwell J1          HEAD WTP_Curve

[CURVES]
;ID              X-Value      Y-Value
 WTP_Curve       0            75
 WTP_Curve       60           65
 WTP_Curve       120          45

[PATTERNS]
;ID              Multipliers
 DemandPat       0.60  0.55  0.80  1.25  1.40  1.20
 DemandPat       1.05  1.00  1.15  1.35  1.10  0.70

[QUALITY]
;Node            InitQual
 WTP_Clearwell   1.40
 EastTank        0.75
 J1              1.20
 J2              1.05
 J3              0.95
 J4              0.85
 J5              0.80
 J6              0.70

[SOURCES]
;Node            Type         Quality      Pattern
 WTP_Clearwell   CONCEN       1.40         ;

[REACTIONS]
 Order Bulk           1
 Order Tank           1
 Order Wall           1
 Global Bulk          -0.55
 Global Wall          -0.18
 Limiting Potential   0.0

[TIMES]
 Duration             48:00
 Hydraulic Timestep   1:00
 Quality Timestep     0:05
 Pattern Timestep     2:00
 Report Timestep      1:00

[OPTIONS]
 Units                LPS
 Headloss             H-W
 Quality              Chlorine mg/L
 Accuracy             0.001
 Trials               40

[END]
